protocol.purpose: Test the previously screened 20% pure-yaw sampler together with the exploration-boundary fix, with paired full-budget fresh training and continuation. No air-time reward change.
protocol.source_note: Beginning-of-turn worktree includes previous uncommitted changes; both snapshots include the prior exploration projection and this turn per-environment evaluation metrics.

variants.mixture: Same RNG draw: 2% stand, 20% pure yaw, 78% forward+yaw. Reward and optimizer unchanged.

continuation.baseline_note: Reuse all three completed full-budget fixed-optimizer baseline continuations. Reevaluate them using the same current evaluator and new evaluation seeds. Training timing is not compared.

evaluation.note: New evaluation seeds, fixed commands, no observation noise, training initial-state/physics distribution. Each row contributes only its first trial; states are paired across commands and weights.

screen.note: All gates use arithmetic means of per-report RMSE, comparing the two directions for yaw. Survival is summed over the six commands; row instances across commands are not independent samples. Local default-change screening, not a statistical significance or hardware acceptance claim.

protocol.budget_rule: Complete all 5000-update fresh and 2500-update continuation jobs; evaluate final checkpoints only. No best-seed or best-checkpoint selection.
limits: Three fresh paired seeds; continuation seeds were selected in the preceding study for weak prior policies.
Reused continuation controls have the same optimizer, sampling and budget; evaluation-report-only changes do not alter training.
Two simultaneous CPU processes with two threads each. GPU excluded. No timing performance claims.
If gates fail retain defaults; do not expose an unvalidated new user-facing training knob.

screen_clarification.reason: Clarify an omitted protocol label before any fresh training job has completed; no numeric thresholds changed.
screen_clarification.rmse_screen_protocol: All yaw and planar RMSE screening gates use nominal fixed-command reports. The randomized screen gates compare survival counts across the randomized fixed-command reports.
screen_clarification.separate_diagnostics: Per-row quality thresholds and command-switch sequences are secondary diagnostics, not additional paths for promoting a candidate that fails the declared screen.

diagnostic_protocol.purpose: Secondary per-initial-state quality diagnostic, separate from the command-mixture screening gates.
limits: These offline row thresholds do not change CLI acceptance, which still uses global metrics.
Passed rows must survive the entire first trial; a low error before an early fall cannot pass.
Multiple commands reuse initial states; row counts across commands are trial instances, not independent samples.
Do not interpret the proportion as a confidence level or hardware acceptance.

sequence_protocol.purpose: Secondary diagnostic: policy response to command switches without resetting surviving rows. Does not change the preregistered fixed-command screen.
sequence_protocol.note: 120 seconds maximum. Initial states are paired across models. Later segment errors condition on surviving earlier segments; report observation counts and cumulative survival, with null errors when no frames remain. Two seeds are initial-state batches, not independent training models. No thresholds or checkpoint selection.

rate_protocol.purpose: Secondary in-distribution yaw-rate generalization check, separate from the fixed 0.5 rad/s screening gates.
rate_protocol.limits: One new initial-state batch per model; paired across rates and policies. Multiple rates reuse the same initial states. Does not supersede the main screen, and is not hardware acceptance.

resource_execution.clarification: The protocol limit of two simultaneous CPU processes describes the training lanes. Cached-control evaluations and command-sequence diagnostics run in an additional CPU process when ready; software checks also execute concurrently. Each H1 training/evaluation process requests two threads. Shared-load wall times are not a performance comparison.

failure_pose_analysis.source: saved first-trial motion and model forward kinematics
failure_pose_analysis.limit: No velocity or randomized force reconstruction; torso contact force is not inferred from this pose-only replay.

paired_fresh_failures.note: Post hoc failure localization; command instances reuse initial states. This diagnostic does not alter the prespecified screening decision.

production_audit.evaluation_extension: Selected-row recording with provenance, validated on the actual failed row and against the frozen evaluator.

recording_comparison.purpose: Post hoc illustration of one observed failure, using matched model, reset seed, randomization and batch size. Not an independent acceptance test or causal isolation of the sampler.

protocol.purpose: Complete the continuation-only 2×2 comparison of exploration-parameter projection and 20% pure-yaw sampling, using all three original input chains. Secondary interaction analysis, not a new promotion screen.

evaluation.note: New evaluation seeds, fixed commands, no observation noise, training initial-state/physics distribution. Each row contributes only its first trial; states are paired across commands and weights.

limits: All four arms share each input checkpoint, continuation seed, 2500-update budget, 128 environments and original reward.
Three arms were trained in the previous study; their training execution must not be counted again.
Current evaluator is shared across all arms; old forward-only-clamp weights remain loadable for deterministic evaluation.
The three weak input chains are not a random sample of all pretrained policies. Interaction is descriptive, without confidence or causal generalization beyond this controlled comparison.

protocol.purpose: Secondary evaluation after the primary screen failed: characterize fresh-policy survival on additional reset batches. Does not override the primary screen, change defaults, or count as independent training replication.
protocol.weights: All six fixed final fresh policies from the primary study; no further training or checkpoint selection.
protocol.execution: Two CPU evaluation lanes, one per variant. Identical reset batches paired across policies and commands.
protocol.analysis: Publish all fixed-command survival counts and mean report RMSE by training seed, variant and command. Retain all failed rows; no threshold tuning.
protocol.primary_decision: Retain original sampler because the prespecified randomized-survival gate failed.

holdout.data_note: Secondary reports retain counts, aggregate RMSE and all failed-row metrics. Full per-row arrays remain in hashed local evaluation.json files.

decision.summary: 保留原指令采样和奖励默认值，接入逐环境评估指标与指定环境的首次试验记录。从零训练三种子的标称原地转向 yaw RMSE 均值从 0.0912 降至 0.0629 rad/s（改善 31.0%），但六类指令的随机试验存活数从 1151/1152 降至 1144/1152，未通过预声明的存活筛选。续训平均转向误差改善 7.5%，也不能覆盖从零训练的退化。所有最终权重和失败结果均保留。 追加八个随机起点 seed 后，存活数仍为原采样 4598/4608、候选 4567/4608；这组补充诊断没有改变主筛选规则。

data_note: Per-environment survival, RMSE and observed-duration arrays are retained. Batched reward and mean-velocity arrays are summarized; full raw artifacts remain at local runs/ paths with SHA256. Reused controls are explicitly distinguished from new execution.
